verdict.rationale: Openness is a fair question for a SaaS email service. The only relevant evidence is the docs' reference to 'open-source SDKs' (client libraries such as @sendgrid/mail), so only the client-side code is described as open, not the SendGrid service itself. missing for 10: open-source availability of the core sending platform/service code, a named open license, links to the source repositories, independent corroboration.
